MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The HDMI cable relates to my DVI cable purchase because both serve a concrete display-connection need, though I would need matching ports and the right length.",
    "The basic USB mouse and wired earbuds fit my history of practical computer and audio accessories, although that relevance alone would not make me replace equipment I already have."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The streaming sticks, smart speaker, and tablet assume I want additional devices when my history mostly shows accessories for equipment I already use.",
    "A security camera does not follow from needing network connectivity, and a TV wall mount does not serve the same purpose as my small-tablet mount.",
    "The trackball requires a preference for a different pointing-device style that I have not expressed."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in computer accessories seems to have been stretched into a broad interest in electronics and connected home devices.",
    "Shared words or features, such as wireless connectivity or mounting, seem to count more than whether the products solve the same problem for me."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My adapter and cable purchases suggest specific connection needs, where ports, compatibility, and intended use matter more than a general resemblance.",
    "My purchases are infrequent and spread over years, so an accessory I bought before does not establish a current replacement need.",
    "Buying an accessory for a tablet or computer does not mean I want to replace the device itself."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognize my interest in practical accessories but extend it too broadly beyond specific, current equipment needs."
}
